definitions.gloss: water supply; clean water; tap water
definitions.explanation: Clean, treated water supplied through a public water system for drinking and domestic use. Contrasted with {下水|げすい} (sewage/wastewater).

examples.japanese: {上水|じょうすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水質|すいしつ}→水質：22420_suishitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To inspect the quality of the water supply.

examples.japanese: {上水|じょうすい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦インフラ→インフラ：09898_infura⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Infrastructure development for both water supply and sewage is needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上水道|じょうすいどう}→上水道：16651_jousuidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧おり、⟦{水漏|みずも}れ→水漏れ：07936_mizumore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{頻繁|ひんぱん}→頻繁：08631_hinpan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きている→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: In this area, the water supply system is aging, and leaks occur frequently.

notes:
Refers to clean, treated water for human consumption, as opposed to ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧ (sewage/wastewater). Composed of ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (upper/above) + {水|すい} (water). The character ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ indicates clean/good water, while {下|げ} in ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧ indicates waste.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{上水道|じょうすいどう}→上水道：16651_jousuidou⟧: water supply system/waterworks
- {上水|じょうすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水質|すいしつ}→水質：22420_suishitsu⟧: water supply quality
- {上水|じょうすい}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: water treatment

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{下水|げすい}→下水：00069_gesui⟧: sewage, wastewater — the counterpart to {上水|じょうすい}
- ⟦{下水道|げすいどう}→下水道：09632_gesuidou⟧: sewage system
- ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧: water supply, plumbing — the general term for tap water infrastructure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水道水|すいどうすい}→水道水：25349_suidousui⟧: tap water — the everyday word for water from the tap
- ⟦{飲料水|いんりょうすい}→飲料水：15275_inryousui⟧: drinking water — water safe for drinking

ETYMOLOGY:
The term {上水|じょうすい} has historical roots in Edo-period water supply systems, such as the famous {玉川上水|たまがわじょうすい} (Tamagawa Aqueduct) built in 1653 to supply water to Edo (Tokyo).
